findings.failureScenario: write_snapshot's contract comment says the catalog.snap bytes are exactly {"format":"lightcraft-catalog","version":1,...}, but the writer emits version {VERSION} (currently 8). Anyone building a reader or a fixture from this documented byte layout writes version 1, which Journal::open then treats as an older format and rewrites (reported as upgraded_from 1), and a v1-gated external tool would reject real snapshots.
findings.action: Change the comment to reference VERSION ("version":V) as the module docs do.
